summary: Completed B034 freshness regression across B017 generation binding and B018 read-time stale semantics. Added a reusable freshness model that evaluates every required source independently, exposes the stalest age, preserves last-good data as LAST_GOOD_ERROR after a failed current fetch, validates the B017 scoreboard/source binding without upgrading it to liveness, and enforces the canonical worker evidence thresholds (<6m fresh, 6-10m suspect, >=10m replaceable). The historical B018 audit test was made forward-safe so fixing the bug no longer causes the audit itself to fail. Regression tests executed successfully.

feature_evidence.requirement: fresh source cannot mask stale required source
feature_evidence.evidence: aggregateRequiredSourceFreshness only reports FRESH when every required source is fresh and reports stalest_age_ms

feature_evidence.requirement: failed refresh keeps last-good bytes but marks stale/error
feature_evidence.evidence: source fetch_error/current_fetch_ok=false yields LAST_GOOD_ERROR even when retained generated_at is recent
validateScoreboardGenerationBinding requires sidecar/schema/time/SHA match and explicitly disclaims read-time freshness/liveness/authority

feature_evidence.requirement: worker older than active threshold is not live capacity
feature_evidence.evidence: classifyWorkerEvidence contributes live capacity only below 6 minutes; 6-10m suspect, >=10m replaceable
B018 audit test now validates frozen audit artifact instead of requiring bad renderer patterns to remain

unresolved: Renderer wiring of the reusable freshness model remains a downstream composition concern; B034 establishes the regression contract and implementation primitive without inventing new UI authority.
